messages:
ida: Quick profiling summary — ran AWQ-int8 vs GPTQ-int8 vs float32 for Mixtral-8B and Qwen-7B on the same workload. AWQ gives ~1.9x token throughput but we see a 3-6% accuracy delta on our long-context eval

ida: Repro steps + artifacts: kernel traces, perf flamegraphs, and a KV cache timeline attached to the run. Observed two symptoms:
- RoPE scale mismatch for sequences > 8k (certain heads show phase offset when AWQ kernels used)
- KV cache eviction pattern is noisy under our batching heuristic which causes re-population hot loops

ida: Minimal runtime config used:
```json
{
  "model": "mixtral-8b",
  "quant_profile": "awq_int8",
  "kernel_order": ["awq_int8", "gptq_int8", "fp32_fallback"],
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 4096, "packing_policy": "time_based", "batch_timeout_ms": 8},
  "kv_cache": {"shard_size": 512, "prefetch": true}
}
```

ida: Calibration prompts (used for AWQ calib run):
- "Summarize the following legal clause and highlight obligations:" + 512-token clause
- "Translate to Spanish (formal) and preserve named entities:" + 128-token doc
- "Long-context code review: explain bug and suggest fix" + 1024-token snippet

taylor: Saw the same RoPE-y offsets on a local repro. Looks correlated with heads where head_dim % 64 != 0. Could be kernel vector-width assumptions in the AWQ attention kernel.

jordan: Interesting — did we observe the same on Qwen-7B? My runs showed smaller accuracy delta but increased latency variance when enabling awq_int8 kernel order first.

maria: From KV side: the packing_policy=time_based plus short timeout spikes creates uneven batch sizes and we end up flushing partially populated KV segments. That explains the noisy re-population. Increasing batch_timeout to 12-16ms made the KV churn smoother in my test.

sam: Actionable next steps I propose:
1) Add a kernel compatibility check: if head_dim % 64 != 0, prefer gptq_int8 or fp32_fallback for attention kernel.
2) Add a RoPE calibration test in nightly perf that runs a 5k and 10k context probe for every model we AWQ.
3) Tweak batching default for long-context workloads to packing_policy=size_based when seq_len > 2048.

jordan: +1 to 1 and 2. For 1 we should also detect per-model RoPE scale (rope_freq) mismatches — some Mixtral variants ship different base frequencies.

ida: FYI sample flame snippet (stack trace of AWQ attention kernel):
```
awq_attn_kernel()
  -> fused_dotprod_qk()
  -> load_q_k_stride_mismatch (vectorized accessor)
  -> apply_rope_scaling(rope_freq=10000.0, seq_idx=8192)
  -> quant_dequant_path()  // small rounding differences accumulate
```

perf-bot: New perf-regression alert created: PRJ-4821 (mixtral-awq-rope-regression). Linked artifacts: s3://perf-runs/1812345678/ (flamegraphs, kv-timeline, calib prompts) :rotating_light:

maria: I can prototype a KV heuristic: track per-shard occupancy and avoid prefetch if eviction_rate > 0.02 within last 60s. That should reduce the hot repop loops.

taylor: Also test using int8 GEMM path with 128-bit vector ops (different kernel) — I suspect current AWQ kernel assumes 64-bit lanes for certain head dims. If we swap to the alternate kernel, throughput drops ~10% but accuracy recovers. Worth exposing as runtime toggle.

sam: Can someone put a short runtime config PR together? Something like:
```diff
+ "kernel_compat_checks": [
+    {"condition": "head_dim % 64 != 0", "prefer": "gptq_int8"},
+    {"condition": "seq_len > 4096 and model in ['mixtral-8b']", "prefer": "fp32_fallback_for_attn"}
+ ]
```

ida: I'll file a follow-up with the exact calibration prompt set and upload a smaller distilled eval harness for quick local runs. Also adding a note: AWQ calibration seems sensitive to the prompt distribution (many code/structured prompts cause slightly larger deltas) — include both code-like and natural language prompts in the nightly test.

jordan: Who wants to own the PR for kernel order logic? I can own the RoPE nightly job if sam or taylor own the kernel check PR.

taylor: I can take the kernel check PR. Will start a branch and push WIP by EOD.

sam: Thx. I've assigned PRJ-4821 to @taylor for kernel checks and @jordan for nightly probe. Maria, assign KV heuristic spike to yourself?

maria: Assigned and starting a small benchmark now. Will post numbers in this thread.

ida: Great — quick note: when we report accuracy delta, include both micro-F1 on the eval set and a raw log-prob KL to capture subtle distributional shifts. That helped surface the AWQ issue earlier.

perf-bot: Reminder: link to perf dashboard -> https://perf.redwood-inference.internal/dashboards/PRJ-4821

ida: Thanks everyone — keeping this short. I'll paste the distilled eval harness link once uploaded. :thumbsup:
